knownIssues: The live Reflex, Runloop, and GitHub write integrations were intentionally not exercised in this credential-free Person B lane.
p-timeout has no lockfile at the historical commits; causal lanes must share one prewarmed Snapshot as specified in docs/real-repo-p-timeout.md.
In-repository receipt publication is disabled by default; enable it only after the target project explicitly accepts .antibody/receipts content.
headCommit records the implementation/docs tip immediately before the manifest commit, avoiding an impossible self-referential commit hash.
integrationInstructions: Person C: export and compose GitHistoryMiner/rankCandidates, CodexAuthoringModule, TestOnlyPatchPolicy, CausalRecoveryVerifier, receipt builder/store, and GitHubDraftPublisher from your owned composition and CLI paths.

Person A: inject the frozen AgentSessionPort and VerificationExecutionPort only. Preserve complete bounded UTF-8 reporter artifacts and provider/environment provenance; do not classify or adjudicate in transport adapters.
Pass discovered recovered-test names into CausalRecoveryVerifier so reporter failures can be attributed to the target rather than unrelated tests.
Before publish, load receipt.json plus receipt.sha256 and patch.diff from the verified run directory; require the human approval string to equal the canonical receipt digest exactly.
Construct OctokitPublisherClient with a token limited to contents read/write and pull-requests write. Do not grant merge, workflow, administration, or issue permissions.
Use the writable-fork and shared-Snapshot steps in docs/real-repo-p-timeout.md for the real demonstration.
